author: musho7-dev
subject: Add Workshop: build your own car from bought parts
body:
- New Workshop screen (Build your car button in the garage): live
  preview with spinning wheels, stat bars, and 6 part tabs
- Parts: 4 bodies, 4 engines (incl. Rocket with flame), 4 wheel types,
  11 paints, 6 decals (clipped to the body shape), 4 extras (spoiler,
  siren, flag, chrome pipes); parts change speed, power, grip, weight
  and air control
- Buy once with coins, then equip freely; extras toggle on/off
- The build appears in the garage as "My Car" and can be driven
- Config and owned parts are saved per player

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
